description.value: Boston Pizza Stadium District is the Vancouver flagship of Canada's largest casual dining chain, a two-level family restaurant and sports bar situated steps from BC Place Stadium at Beatty and Robson. The location was renovated and reopened in 2018 and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. The brand traces its roots to 1964 Edmonton and now operates hundreds of franchise locations across Canada.
